Packages that use com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.provider
Package
Description
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.provider
Live cloud-provider pricing adapters: RateCard implementations that source current data-egress list prices from the providers' public pricing APIs — AwsPriceListRateCard (AWS Price List bulk offers), AzureRetailPricesRateCard (Azure Retail Prices), GcpBillingCatalogRateCard (GCP Cloud Billing Catalog; the only one needing an API key), and OracleCloudPriceListRateCard (OCI Price List).
  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.provider used by com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.provider
    Class
    Description
    AwsPriceListRateCard
    A RateCard that sources AWS data-egress rates from the public AWS Price List Bulk API.
    AzureRetailPricesRateCard
    A RateCard that sources cloud-egress rates from the public Azure Retail Prices API (https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices).
    GcpBillingCatalogRateCard
    A RateCard that sources Google Cloud data-egress rates from the Cloud Billing Catalog API (https://cloudbilling.googleapis.com/v1/services/{service}/skus).
    OracleCloudPriceListRateCard
    A RateCard that sources Oracle Cloud (OCI) internet data-egress rates from the public OCI Price List API (https://apexapps.oracle.com/pls/apex/cetools/api/v1/products/).
